title: Internal Helper
hints: Two packages: `slug` (in `internal/slug/`) does the text work; `blog` only calls `slug.Make`. Because `blog.go` sits in the parent of `internal/`, the import is allowed; a package outside this exercise would get `use of internal package … not allowed`.

In `Make`, range over the runes with a `strings.Builder` and a `dash bool`. A rune that isn't a letter or digit only sets `dash = true`. Before writing a kept rune, write `'-'` if `dash` is set **and** the builder isn't empty, then reset `dash`.

In `NewPosts`, keep `taken := map[string]bool{}`. For each title call `NewPost`; on error `return nil, fmt.Errorf("title %d: %w", i, err)`. If `taken[p.Slug]`, loop `for n := 2; taken[p.Slug]; n++ { p.Slug = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", base, n) }`, then mark it taken and append.
